instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the missing word.

atoms.a: She couldn’t find the letter because it was hidden under miscellaneous papers.
atoms.b: She couldn’t find the letter because it was hidden under ((miscellaneous)) papers.

atoms.a: I made the conscious decision to become vegetarian.
atoms.b: I made the ((conscious)) decision to become vegetarian.

atoms.a: Abbie is still young, which is why she needs continuous supervision near any body of water.
atoms.b: Abbie is still young, which is why she needs ((continuous)) supervision near any body of water.

atoms.a: Every time my phone rings, I get very anxious.
atoms.b: Every time my phone rings, I get very ((anxious)).

atoms.a: Babylon used to be a very prosperous city.
atoms.b: Babylon used to be a very ((prosperous)) city.
